name: @aise/anchoring-contract
description: AISE shared anchoring contract (ANCHOR-002, SHARED): the provider-neutral anchoring port lifted from the ANCHOR-001 spike into a typed zod-coded wire contract — AnchoringRequest/AnchoringResponse over the anchor002-anchoring-contract/1 process boundary, the rasterToScene HANDEDNESS LAW as a first-class field, the typed PARTIAL outcome with per-still results, the three port laws as tested invariants (no provider type crosses — unknown fields refused with the field named; AISE owns identity — ids echoed never invented, provider refs only in externalReferences; fail closed before anchoring with the declared gate order and zero hypotheses on every refusal), the AISE-side supervised subprocess runner (input digest, timeout, stdio JSON, output guard) and the evaluation-stage provider-registry registration of the OpenCV reference lane. Additive only — no canonical solution semantics, no frozen evidence tree, no app surface is touched.
